description.value: Daan Go Cake Lab is a specialty dessert bakery in Richmond's Garden City neighbourhood, founded by Chef Christopher Siu — the 2019 Milk Tea King and MasterChef Canada Season 7 champion. The shop is known for Asian-inspired signature cakes, artisan croissants, and elaborately designed macarons, with a Toronto location as well as multiple Metro Vancouver stores. A touring cyclist passing through Richmond will find a distinctive pit stop for a high-quality sweet treat.
